name: Barbarian
author: dreinecke
description: Barbarian — the bar arranger: two columns (far-left and right lanes) or icon-only rows, drag to reorder or re-lane, eye/x or right-click menu to hide; written to shell.json + bar-hidden.json when the panel closes. Its Themes button (or HYPER+X) opens a full-screen grid of every theme, to remove your own or hide Omarchy's.

barWidget.description: Two-column arrange/hide panel for the bar (HYPER+B).
